predecessors.name: Sheikhdom of Qatar
predecessors.text: the peninsula under Abdullah bin Jassim Al Thani after the Ottoman garrison left in 1915

successors.name: State of Qatar
successors.text: the independent State of Qatar from 3 September 1971; Cliopatria's row starts in 1973

ledger.x: 3 November 1916: Qatar becomes a British protectorate.
3 September 1971: the protectorate ends in independence.

certainty.note: The peninsula's coast is sharp; the land frontier with Saudi Arabia and the Hawar and Zubarah disputes with Bahrain were unsettled (the pages opened give the 2001 court ruling but no earlier line and no border treaty).
